patch_description: This version uses a sequential linear-programming contact method rather than relying only on nonlinear local optimization from a few fixed lattice seeds. At each iteration, circle-separation constraints are replaced by supporting tangent half-planes to the distance disks, producing a linear program that jointly moves centers and increases radii while remaining feasible. Multiple staggered, boundary-adapted layer patterns are explored. The best certified LP packing is then polished with an analytic-Jacian SLSQP solve, followed by a final global feasibility scaling certificate.
